title: Business calendar form
purpose: Create a business calendar or change its name, weekly opening hours and whether it is active. Editing needs a reason.
summary: Name a calendar and type its opening hours for each weekday. Editing needs a reason. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Create a calendar
steps: Type the opening hours for each weekday, for example 7-19, and leave closed days empty.
Select [[Create calendar]]. Then add its holidays.

tasks.title: Change the opening hours
steps: Edit the weekday fields and write the [[Reason for change]].

tasks.title: Write a night shift
steps: Split it at midnight. Put 22:00-24:00 on the evening's day and 00:00-06:00 on the next day.

good_to_know: Give at least one opening interval. A calendar with no hours at all is refused.
Typed times can be short: 7-19, 0700-1900 and 07:00-19:00 all mean the same. They are shown as HH:MM after saving.
A calendar used by active service targets cannot be made inactive. Change those targets first.
Changed hours apply to tickets created or recalculated afterwards.

items.label: Calendar name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters, unique among calendars. Surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Monday to Sunday
items.description: One field per weekday, up to 200 characters. Empty means closed (the field shows Closed as a hint). Separate several intervals with commas, for example 07:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. An inactive calendar is not offered for new targets. Refused while active targets use the calendar.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Edit only, required. Kept with the change in the history.

sections.title: How hours are read
paragraphs: Each interval is start-end in 24-hour time. The start and end can be separated with a hyphen, an en or em dash, or the word to. Hours alone (7) and four digits (0700) are accepted, and minutes must be 00 to 59. 24:00 is allowed only as an end.

An interval must end after it starts, so one cannot run past midnight. Split a night shift at midnight. Intervals on a day must be in time order and must not overlap; they may touch, such as 08:00-12:00 then 12:00-17:00.
A message beside the weekday field names the part that cannot be read. When any day has a problem, nothing is saved and what you typed stays.

items.label: Create calendar / Save changes
items.description: Saving a new calendar opens its page. Saving a change returns to the calendar's page. Each change is audited with the person, time and, for changes, the reason and the values before and after. A save with no change is refused with Change at least one detail before saving.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the calendar changed after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload and review it.

items.label: Inactive notice
items.description: While the stored calendar is inactive the form says it is not used for new tickets.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Business calendars when creating, or to the calendar's page when editing, without saving.
